'''R5''' was the personnel [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] to [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] flew with Janson during the [[Malrev incident]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="X-Wing" />
